components.name: Status
components.description:
Active: listed normally on the landing page.
Archived: listed under 'Archived Missions' below the active ones (omitted entirely if 'Hide Archived Missions' is on in General Options) but still fully accessible.
Hidden: never shown on the landing page and only visible here in Configure. Other missions can still point to this mission's data and it stays reachable by URL.

components.name: /Missions Folder Name
components.description: The actual folder name in the /Missions directory. This should match the physical folder name to ensure relative links work correctly. If the folder name differs from the mission name in the database, update this value accordingly.

components.name: Planet / Moon
components.description: Body this mission targets (e.g. 'Mars', 'Europa'). Shown at the top right of the card and used to group cards when the landing page groups by planet. Leave blank to omit.

components.name: Dot Color
components.description: Small shaded dot shown beside the planet/moon name. When no banner image is set, the banner uses a matching gradient. Select 'none' to omit.

components.name: Banner Image URL
components.description: Full-width image across the top of the card. Accepts an absolute URL, a mission-relative path ('banner.png' → Missions/[mission]/banner.png), or a public asset ('public/images/...'). Leave blank for a gradient based on the dot color, or a consistent default derived from the mission name.

components.name: Subtitle
components.description: Short line shown directly under the mission name (e.g. 'Perseverance Rover · Jezero Crater'). Leave blank to omit.

components.name: Description
components.description: Longer blurb shown under the subtitle, clamped to three lines. Leave blank to omit.
